welcome:
An gama! ✅ Ku aiko mini da voice note ko rubutu kamar:
• "Na sayi data 1,500"
• "Albashina ya shigo, 150k"
• "Kasafin abincina na wannan watan 40k ne"
• "Ina bin Mama Chidi 5k"
• "Na sayar da buhun shinkafa uku, 75k"
• "Ina kuɗina ke tafiya a wannan makon?"

Ku rubuta HELP kowane lokaci, ko UNDO don goge rikodi na ƙarshe.
help:
Ga abin da zan iya yi:
🛒 Ciniki ko aikin da kuka yi: "Na sayar da kiret ɗin ƙwai biyu 9k", "Na karɓi 8k na ɗinki"
💸 Kashe kuɗi: "Na biya kuɗin hayar shago 30k", "Na sayi data 1,500", "Na ci abinci 2k"
💰 Kuɗin shiga: "Albashina ya shigo 150k", "Babana ya turo mini 20k"
📒 Bashi: "Ina bin Emeka 4k", "Emeka ya biya ni 4k", "Mai kawo mini kaya yana bina 20k"
🎯 Kasafin kuɗi: "Kasafin abincina na wannan watan 40k ne"
📦 Kaya: "Ina da katan 10 na Indomie da suka rage"
📊 Taƙaitawa: "Ina kuɗina ke tafiya a wannan makon?"
🏦 Rance: "Ina buƙatar rancen 100k don sayen kaya"
💡 Shawarar kuɗi: ku yi kowace tambaya

✏️ Kun yi kuskure? Ku ce "ba 5k ba ne, 50k ne", ko ku rubuta UNDO don goge rikodi na ƙarshe.
Ku rubuta SHARE don gayyatar abokai, LANGUAGE don canza harshe, DELETE don goge bayananku.

Sọ̀rọ̀ yana amfani da N-ATLaS, wani shiri na Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy, wanda Awarri Technologies ke ƙarfafawa.

unsupported_type: Don Allah ku aiko da voice note ko rubutu. Ba zan iya karanta hoto ko bidiyo ba tukuna.

error: Ku yi haƙuri, wani abu ya lalace a ɓangarenmu. Don Allah ku sake gwadawa nan da minti ɗaya.
